name: cadre-lifecycle-github
description: GitHub-flavored Agentic SDLC gate governance: lifecycle-review-github records lifecycle gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review; link-source-issue-github records a real GitHub issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate; create-github-gate-issues publishes GitHub tracking issues per applicable lifecycle gate plus linked approval issues assigned to each gate's authority; report-gate-reviewers-github reports (read-only, never requests) which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates; publish-gate-status-github posts (and idempotently updates) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on a task's GitHub PR; publish-reviewer-nudge-github posts (and idempotently updates) an advisory, SUGGESTION-ONLY comment naming reviewer candidates -- never a review request and never notifies anyone. Bundles its own onboarding, generic gate-decision, pending-gates briefing, and kernel bootstrap skills (lifecycle-onboarding-github, lifecycle-review-generic-github, brief-pending-gates-github), so cadre-lifecycle-core is optional -- only needed for forge-agnostic-only use elsewhere. If you don't have a GitHub review to cite, the bundled generic lifecycle-review-generic-github skill covers that case.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitHub pull request review, or record a real GitHub issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate, or publish GitHub tracking issues per applicable lifecycle gate plus linked approval issues assigned to each gate's authority, or report (read-only, never requests) which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates, or post (and idempotently update) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on a task's GitHub PR, or post (and idempotently update) an advisory, suggestion-only comment naming reviewer candidates -- never a review request and never notifies anyone. Bundles its own onboarding, generic gate-decision, and pending-gates briefing skills plus kernel bootstrap -- cadre-lifecycle-core is optional.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-onboarding-github to set up Agentic SDLC lifecycle tracking for this project.
Use lifecycle-review-github to record a gate decision from a GitHub PR review.
Use lifecycle-review-generic-github to record a gate decision when there's no GitHub review to cite.
Use brief-pending-gates-github for a local-only briefing of pending gates and who needs to sign off.
Use link-source-issue-github to record a GitHub issue as the source for a task's G1 or G2 gate.
Use create-github-gate-issues to publish GitHub tracking issues for a task's lifecycle gates and linked approval issues assigned to each gate's authority.
Use report-gate-reviewers-github to see which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (read-only, never requests).
Use publish-gate-status-github to post or refresh a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on this task's GitHub PR.
Use publish-reviewer-nudge-github to post or refresh an advisory, suggestion-only reviewer nudge comment on this task's GitHub PR (never a review request, never notifies anyone).

kernelInstall.title: Kernel install mode
kernelInstall.description: How to obtain the Agentic SDLC kernel. 'auto' (default) lets this plugin install and manage its own copy under its data directory. 'system' uses only a kernel you installed yourself and never installs anything. 'off' disables the check entirely -- set AGENTIC_SDLC_BIN yourself. Unrecognized values are treated as 'auto'.

profile.title: Provider profile
profile.description: Provider profile id passed to `agentic-sdlc init`, e.g. secure-cloud. Leave blank for kernel-only lifecycle operation with no profile.
